title: Ned's Gift
note: b416 — Phase 4 complete (Learning) — new consonant clusters nd, nt, nk, ft, lt, lf.

pages.brief: Ned the duckling walking along a garden path, looking down at the ground.
Ned the duckling noticing a small bent metal pin glinting on the path.
Ned the duckling spotting a small flat pale shell beside the path.
Ned the duckling finding a small pink wood chip on the path.
Ned the duckling holding the pin, shell and pink chip together, looking pleased.
Ned the duckling threading the pin, shell and chip carefully onto a length of string.
Ned the duckling holding up the finished string of little treasures.
Nell the bee taking the string of treasures from Ned the duckling.
Nell the bee grinning widely, holding the little string of treasures up proudly.
